source.snippet: I received a set of 3D CAD models from an organization in Parasolid (.x_t) format. My ultimate goal is to optimize and process them in Blender, and then export them into Unity. However, I am struggling with the CAD-to-Mesh conversion. I have already tried using ABViewer 16, FreeCAD 1.1, CAD Assistant, and Plasticity, but the results are always broken. The exported meshes come out distorted, with broken geomet...

problem_statement: Professionals working at the intersection of CAD engineering and real-time 3D (game engines, AR/VR) cannot reliably convert Parasolid and other B-rep CAD formats into clean, game-ready meshes — existing tools produce broken geometry, costing studios hours of manual repair work per model.
target_segment: 3D artists, technical artists, and visualization engineers at game studios, architectural visualization firms, and industrial simulation companies that receive CAD assets from engineering partners.
notes: Buyer is a professional studio or agency receiving CAD from clients/partners — a clear commercial workflow. User tried 4 paid/professional tools (ABViewer, FreeCAD, CAD Assistant, Plasticity) and all failed, indicating willingness to pay for a working solution. Single signal but represents a known recurring pain in the archviz/gamedev/industrial-sim space. A SaaS conversion API or batch pipeline tool is a plausible product.
